summary: web_search: allowlist of trusted domains per case/skill, not only a blocklist
description:
Source: team sync 2026-11-04. An agent that can search anywhere can be steered by a planted page. The owner's direction: limit search to known sources.

**Today:** `runtime/websearch.py` has a per-run **blocklist** (the answer-leak guard), and a result that touches a blocked domain is withheld whole.

**Want:**

* an **allowlist** declared host-side (case file or skill frontmatter; never by the agent), e.g. rtems.org, docs.rtems.org, lists.rtems.org, savannah.nongnu.org (lwIP), osv.dev, nvd.nist.gov, eur-lex.europa.eu (CRA);
* results whose sources fall outside the list are dropped, with a note to the agent;
* the blocklist still applies on top.

**Acceptance:** tests for allowed, outside the list, and blocked results; TC2 and TC3 declare their lists.

comments.body:
[claude] Done, with one part of the acceptance moved to ANVIL-50 (below). Merged as 7c8f8b7 (PR #97; devin approved after the last commit, re-confirmed after a merge-from-main commit; CI green).

Acceptance:

* **Allowed, outside the list, blocked:** `tests/test_websearch.py`: `test_allowlisted_result_passes_and_the_query_names_the_sources`, `test_a_page_outside_the_allowlist_withholds_the_whole_result` (a page that was only opened, not cited, still withholds; the planted text never reaches the agent), `test_retry_recovers_when_the_second_answer_stays_on_the_list`, `test_blocklist_still_wins_over_the_allowlist`, `test_allowlist_matching_is_host_and_path_segment_exact`.
* **Declared host-side, never by the agent:** the case's `[web] allow` (`Case.web_allow`), else `ANVIL_WEB_ALLOWLIST`; wired in `runtime_factory._web_allowlist(run)`. Empty = unrestricted, as before. `test_deepagent_executor_receives_host_tools_and_hooks` shows RTEMS-1 gets TC1's list and a caseless run gets the env default.
* **TC2 declares its list:** `cases/rtems-lwip-2.2.1.toml` (docs.rtems.org, the lwIP project pages on nongnu.org, osv.dev, nvd.nist.gov). TC1 and the 5806 case too; `test_cases_declare_trusted_sources_and_never_allow_a_blocked_one` checks no case allows a blocklisted host.

**Moved to ANVIL-50:** TC3 has no case file on main (it runs through interactive intake), so there is nowhere host-side to declare its list yet. Its list (eur-lex.europa.eu, digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu, enisa.europa.eu, osv.dev, nvd.nist.gov, cve.org) is now an acceptance item on ANVIL-50. Until then a TC3 run is unrestricted unless `ANVIL_WEB_ALLOWLIST` is set in the environment.

Not seen: a live search through the real gateway with an allowlist (the tests use a mocked gateway).
